name: StrokePoint++
chinese_name: 卒中脑血管点云识别工具箱
purpose: Research cerebral vessel anatomical labeling, not validated stroke diagnosis/prognosis

components.Gate-AppYZ-v1: Sealed historical pairedCTMR internal65 application; not modified
components.Gate-MRA-R0v2: Fixed-recipe reconstructed heads; single-MRA external transfer, not original fitted state recovery
components.StrokePoint-3D: Enhanced3D U-Net short fixed pilot, not fully trained complete nnU-Net
components.StrokePoint-Fuse: Same-input simple concatenation comparator, not a proven new mechanism
components.research/archive: Joint/feedback and previous negative studies; original STOP retained

reproducibility_scope: Executable parameterized inference/array algorithms with caller-owned exact assets and prepared visible inputs; no turnkey raw-image preprocessing validation claimed
